basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old graphic designer from Austin, Texas, who recently got into 3D modeling with Blender. I love technology and gaming, particularly MMORPGs like WildStar, although it's been shut down for a while. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM CST. I'm currently single and focusing on improving my skills in digital art and design.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for about 4 years. I recently started learning Blender as a hobby, mostly through online tutorials and community forums. My background in graphic design helps me understand the basics, but I'm still learning about the technical aspects of 3D rendering and hardware compatibility.
